security_problem: A path-permission check authorizes a mutable name, not the resource that receives the WRITE. After authorization, a swapped identity (symlink/alias claim) can redirect the effect outside the mandate. Trusted: EvaluationRoot identities, mandate, prerequisite booleans. Untrusted: requested/resolved paths, symlink flags, presentation names, claimed proofs.
required_behavior: Authorize ignores ObservedArtifact and returns EvaluateResourceIdentityProof(EvaluationRoot). Proof VALID iff authorized and effect-time identities are non-empty and equal, a USER-or-higher mandate names that effect-time identity. ALLOW additionally requires path permission and WRITE. Evidence is the fixed eight-element array on Decision.
failure_behavior: The scripted path-only baseline fires its callback. Visor denies the swapped root with identity continuity FAILED and does not fire. Unknown enums, missing identities, continuity mismatch, mandate mismatch, and failed prerequisites deny.
non_goals: Real symlink races or TOCTOU timing
Real filesystem reads, writes, opens, renames, links, or stats
inotify, fanotify, inode syscalls, file descriptors, locks, or hostile namespaces
Device, mount, filesystem, container, or kernel identity inspection
HMACs, MACs, signatures, certificates, or cryptographic attestation
Content hashes as identity or trust
Proxy, tools/call, policy, audit, receipt, or CLI integration
Control-plane receipts or persistent proof formats
NLP, model calls, classifiers, embeddings, or prompt parsing
Graphs, provenance stores, histories, journals, or replay systems
Remote identity implementations for ARN, commit SHA, Kubernetes UID, DNS, or SaaS resources

attack_classes.expected: authorized identity A differs from effect-time identity B
an allowed requested path cannot stand in for object identity
symlink flags and targets cannot affect authorization
claimed VALID/ALLOW fields cannot authorize an invalid root
copied legitimate identity claims cannot authorize a swapped root
mandate for A cannot authorize effect on B
unknown trust classes produce INVALID and DENY
